Roads by class on the preview base (important roads on top).

Inputs: `base: image`, `roads: road_lines`  
Outputs: `image: image`

Parameters:

- `line_width` (integer, default `2`, >= 1): Line width.
- `road_types` (list of string, default `["trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "unclassified"]`): Drawing order: the first on top.

## roads.terrain

Version 1

Terrain under the country roads: level across, profile smoothed and grade-limited, cut/fill with banks (width =
change / bank slope); `keep_free` (water and its border) stays as it is. `core` = pixels at full weight.

Inputs: `heights: field`, `roads: road_lines`, `keep_free: mask`, `map_format: map_format`  
Outputs: `heights: field`, `core: mask`

Parameters:

- `width_game_m` (table of number): Carriageway + shoulder per road class (game m).
- `default_width_game_m` (number, default `6.0`, unit game m, > 0): Width of other classes.
- `sink_game_m` (number, default `0.2`, unit game m): Lower the road by this much.
- `profile_smooth_game_m` (number, default `40.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Smooth the longitudinal profile.
- `max_grade` (number, default `0.12`, > 0): Steepest grade along the road (height / distance).
- `max_change_game_m` (number, default `3.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Change the terrain at most this much.
- `bank_slope` (number, default `0.6`, > 0): Bank slope (height / width); smaller = flatter, wider bank.
- `blend_min_px` (number, default `1.5`, > 0): Transition to the side at least (heightmap pixels).

## settle.terrain

Version 1

Evens out the terrain around towns (tilted plane, slope limited) and industries (level; fishing grounds and
industries on water left out) before the water is shaped; `water` stays as it is. Overlapping sites are averaged by
weight (no step between planes); the border is noisy and blends into the terrain.

Inputs: `heights: field`, `water: mask`, `land_min_m: number`, `map_format: map_format`, `towns: town_list` (optional), `industries: json_document` (optional)  
Outputs: `heights: field`, `preview: image`

Parameters:

- `town_radius_game_m` (number, default `250.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Base radius of a town.
- `town_radius_per_sqrt_capacity` (number, default `20.0`, >= 0): + this per square root of the start capacity.
- `town_radius_max_game_m` (number, default `1000.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Largest town radius.
- `town_max_slope` (number, default `0.06`, >= 0): Steepest town plane (height / distance, game).
- `radius_by_site_game_m` (table of number): Radius around industries by site kind (factory, field = with fields/pits, compact = in the mountains).
- `blend_game_m` (number, default `200.0`, unit game m, > 0): Width of the transition to the terrain outside.
- `edge_noise_game_m` (number, default `80.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Border shifted by up to this much (0 = round).
- `edge_noise_wave_game_m` (number, default `300.0`, unit game m, > 0): Structure size of the border noise.
- `strength` (number, default `1.0`, >= 0, <= 1): 1 = fully onto the plane.
- `max_change_game_m` (number, default `15.0`, unit game m, >= 0): At most this much cut/fill.
- `seed` (integer, default `5`): Random seed of the border noise.

## towns.plan

Version 1

Towns at OSM places with a population, largest first, on buildable land (dry, no glacier or rock, gentle
slope) at a minimum distance; start capacity from the population. `heights` = real heights as the game will see
them (decoded heightmap), `heightmap` = its pixels (0 = real water core). Outputs the town list, the map editor's
import file (towns only) and a preview.

Inputs: `heights: field`, `heightmap: image`, `black_m: number`, `water: mask`, `shore: mask`, `glacier: mask`, `rock: mask`, `places: osm_points`, `biome_preview: image`, `map_format: map_format`  
Outputs: `towns: town_list`, `lua: text_document`, `preview: image`

Parameters:

- `max_towns` (integer, default `0`, >= 0): At most this many towns, the largest first (0 = from towns_per_100_km2 and the map area).
- `towns_per_100_km2` (number, default `3.8`, >= 0): Towns per 100 km² game area when max_towns = 0.
- `place_types` (list of string, default `["city", "town", "village"]`): OSM place values that can become towns.
- `min_population` (integer, default `300`, >= 0): Smaller places never.
- `town_without_population` (boolean, default `false`): City/town without a population count with min_population.
- `min_distance_game_m` (number, default `3500.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Minimum distance to all towns placed already (centre to centre).
- `cell_px` (integer, default `8`, >= 1): Check grid of the building ground (heightmap pixels).
- `max_slope` (number, default `0.15`, > 0): Steepest mean slope in game (height / distance) within core_game_m.
- `core_game_m` (number, default `150.0`, unit game m, > 0): Radius around the centre that must be buildable (dry, no glacier/rock).
- `snap_radius_game_m` (number, default `600.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Move a place at most this far, else skip it.
- `pop_to_capacity` (list of [integer, integer], default `[[300, 45], [1000, 110], [5000, 210], [20000, 400], [100000, 800], [1000000, 1400]]`): Population -> start capacity per area like the editor (logarithmic in between).
- `capacity_classes` (list of [integer, string], default `[[80, "hamlet"], [150, "village"], [270, "small town"], [550, "town"], [1000, "city"], [1000000000,  ...`): Editor size classes (upper capacity limit, name) - for the log.
- `start_scale` (number, default `1.0`, > 0): All start sizes multiplied by this (e.g. 0.5 = half, they grow in game).
- `min_start_capacity` (integer, default `45`, >= 0): Never smaller than this (a hamlet).
- `ignore_size` (boolean, default `false`): Ignore the real town size: all towns start at min_start_capacity (start_scale unused); places are still chosen largest first.
- `com_cargo` (list of string, default `["vegetables", "fish", "meat"]`): Commercial cargo demand in turns (like the game's random maps).
- `ind_cargo` (list of string, default `["planks", "bricks", "fuel"]`): Industrial cargo demand in turns.
- `flip_y` (boolean, default `false`): North is -y in game.
- `preview_width` (integer, default `2000`, >= 100): Width of the preview picture in pixels.

## water.layers

Version 1

Water and shore import layers: water = core without real water (the game shows real water itself), optionally
shrunk; shore = border + the cut-off ring, narrower and of random width at real water. `no_cover` = water and
border, where no other layer may lie (no trees in the water).

Inputs: `core: mask`, `border: mask`, `real: mask`  
Outputs: `water: mask`, `shore: mask`, `no_cover: mask`

Parameters:

- `border_game_m` (number, default `25.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Full border width around painted water (the bank border of `water.shape`).
- `texture_shrink_game_m` (number, default `0.0`, unit game m, >= 0): Shrink the water texture inwards; the ring becomes shore (0 = no).
- `real_shore_texture_share` (number, default `0.5`, >= 0, <= 1): Shore texture at real water only 0..this share of the border width.
- `real_shore_texture_wave_game_m` (number, default `200.0`, unit game m, > 0): Wave length of the random shore width at real water.

## water.shape

Version 1

Levels lakes, smooths rivers, adds the real river bands of the river plan, shapes banks and real water.

Outputs: terrain, landcover with shore and river classes, water core / levelled border / real water on the
heightmap grid, and the painted riverbed pieces of the plan.

Inputs: `heights: field`, `landcover: classes`, `land_min_m: number`, `map_format: map_format`, `rivers: river_plan` (optional)  
Outputs: `heights: field`, `landcover: classes`, `core: mask`, `border: mask`, `real: mask`, `beds: bed_segments`

Parameters:

- `real_water_until_m` (number \| none, default `null`, unit m): Real water (game water) only up to this height above sea level (the region's "real water up to"); None = 120 m above the lowest land. Higher = more real water, but real water is cut down to the water line (deep trenches).
- `water_sink_m` (number, default `40.0`, unit m, >= 0): Core of real water this much below the water line (black of the heightmap).
- `shore_class` (integer, default `200`, >= 0, <= 255): Own landcover class of the shore (not a WorldCover code).
- `report_min_ha` (number, default `20.0`, unit ha, >= 0): Lakes from this size are listed in the log.
- `bodies` ([BodyParams](#bodyparams), default `{"min_area_ha": 0.25, "lake_max_range_m": 8.0, "lake_level_percentile": 25.0, "river_min_elongation" ...`): Which water areas become lakes, rivers or are discarded.
- `banks` ([BankParams](#bankparams), default `{"border_game_m": 25.0, "smooth_by_slope": true, "smooth_factor": 4.0, "max_game_m": 150.0, "max_rea ...`): Border and banks around the water.
- `real` ([RealWaterParams](#realwaterparams), default `{"edge_smooth_game_m": 10.0, "bed_ramp_game_m": 40.0, "bed_smooth_game_m": 6.0, "shore_width_game_m" ...`): Real water (game water): soft edge, bed ramp, shore strip.

# Value types

## AreaProduct

Coverage of `first` x `second`.

- `kind` ("product", default `"product"`)
- `first` ([LayerArea](#layerarea) \| [GameArea](#gamearea) \| [AreaProduct](#areaproduct) \| [SteepWaterArea](#steepwaterarea), required): First area.
- `second` ([LayerArea](#layerarea) \| [GameArea](#gamearea) \| [AreaProduct](#areaproduct) \| [SteepWaterArea](#steepwaterarea), required): Second area.

## BankParams

- `border_game_m` (number, default `25`): Border around the water (levelled, shore texture).
- `smooth_by_slope` (boolean, default `true`): Bank width from the terrain slope (else smooth_factor x depth).
- `smooth_factor` (number, default `4`): Without bank slope: bank width = levelling depth x this factor.
- `max_game_m` (number, default `150`): Bank width at most (painted water).
- `max_real_game_m` (number, default `250`): Bank width at most at real water.
- `sigma_game_m` (number, default `15`): Gaussian radius per smoothing pass.
- `passes` (integer, default `30`): Number of Gaussian smoothing passes in the bank zone.
- `bank_slope` ([number, number], default `[0.05, 0.5]`): Target bank slope: flattest .. steepest.
- `bank_slope_factor` (number, default `1`): Target bank slope = terrain slope x this factor (limited to bank_slope).
- `slope_smooth_game_m` (number, default `100`): Terrain slope averaged over this radius.
- `flat_slope` (number, default `0.08`): Terrain flatter than this slope (height / distance) gets extra passes.
- `passes_flat` (integer, default `30`): Extra smoothing passes in flat terrain.

## BilingualText

- `de` (string, required): German.
- `en` (string, required): English.

## BiomeFactor

Maximum share of the secondary look: `default` everywhere unless overridden for a biome ID (0..4).

- `default` (number, required): Share of the secondary look where the transition mask is full (0..1).
- `by_biome` (table of number, default `{}`): Different share per biome ID (1 = valley, 2 = mountain forest, 3 = subalpine, 4 = alpine).

## BodyParams

- `min_area_ha` (number, default `0.25`): Smaller areas are discarded (misclassified, tiny ponds on slopes).
- `lake_max_range_m` (number, default `8`): Height spread (5th-95th percentile) up to which an area is levelled (lake).
- `lake_level_percentile` (number, default `25`): Lake level = this percentile of the heights in the area.
- `river_min_elongation` (number, default `5`): Length/width from which a too steep area counts as river.
- `keep_area_ha` (number, default `10`): Larger too steep areas are never discarded but smoothed like rivers.
- `river_smooth_game_m` (number, default `100`): Smoothing of the river surface along its course.
- `isolated_real_max_m` (number, default `15`): Lakes without connection to a real river: real only up to this height above the water line.

## BuildArea

A test section of the map: only the paths inside are built.

- `center_uv` ([number, number], required): Centre (u, v) of a test section of the map.
- `half_game_m` (number, required): Half the edge length of the test section.

## ClassicTrees

TF2 trees of the base game mixed into the forest (sets named by a startup script).

- `sets` (table of [integer, list of string], required): Set name -> (index in the forest output, tree models).
- `pine_set` (string, required): Set used for Scots pine.
- `broadleaf_set` (string, required): Set used for the broadleaf mix.
- `pine_share` (number, required): Share of Scots pine in the conifer forest (below pine_max).
- `pine_max` (number, required): Scots pine only below this elevation (m a.s.l.).
- `broadleaf_share` (number, required): Share of lime/maple/oak in the broadleaf forest.
- `noise_frequency` (number, required): Stands instead of single trees (larger = smaller stands).

## ClimatePreset

Base game climate, height rules, layers on slots, surfaces, game ground rules, trees and rocks.

- `name` (string, required): Name of the landscape type (used in the climate mod's name).
- `base_climate` (string, required): Game climate the mod is based on (temperate).
- `heights` ([HeightLimits](#heightlimits), required): Height rules.
- `slots` ([SlotPlan](#slotplan), required): Import layers on the 12 layer slots.
- `surfaces` (table of [Surface](#surface), required): Surfaces by key: where each kind of ground lies and how it looks (painted in this order).
- `ground` ([GameGroundRules](#gamegroundrules), required): How own layers extend the game's rock, scree and forest floor.
- `forest` ([ForestParams](#forestparams), required): Trees.
- `rocks` ([RockAssetParams](#rockassetparams), required): Rock assets.
- `no_cover_below` (number, required): No trees and rocks below this game height (0 = water line; m).
- `top` (number, required): 'Infinitely high' in curves (game metres).
- `map_preview_level` (number, required): Middle colour level of the map preview (m a.s.l., cosmetic).

## ClimateTexts

Texts and pictures of a published climate mod (a value of configs/mod_texts/<texts>.toml).

- `summary` (string, required): Short description in the mod hub (placeholders {factor}, {ref}).
- `tags` (list of string, required): Tags in the mod hub.
- `description` ([BilingualText](#bilingualtext), required): Mod description; placeholders {label} {ref} {factor} {factor_de} {conifer_start} {conifer_full} {tree_line} {snow_start} {snow_full} {economy_de} {economy_en} {name} (landscape) {prefix} {beta}.
- `economy` ([EconomyTexts](#economytexts), required): Paragraph about the economy ({economy_de}, {economy_en} in the description).
- `climate_description` ([BilingualText](#bilingualtext), required): In-game climate description (placeholders {factor}, {ref}).
- `strings_de` (table of string, default `{}`): German translations of further in-game texts.
- `picture` (string, required): Picture of the mod thumbnail and the climate tile (relative to the working directory).
- `icon_size` ([integer, integer], default `[700, 400]`): Size of the climate tile when creating a map (px).

## ConstantIntensity

- `kind` ("constant", default `"constant"`)
- `value` (number, required): Material strength inside a patch (0..1, below 1 the ground below shows through).

## CropPlan

Crop types of the fields (a value of the climate preset); each key needs an import layer crop_<key>.

- `shares` (table of number, default `{"wheat": 0.4, "corn": 0.2, "soil": 0.1}`): Crop key -> share of the cropland (parcels from WorldCover); the rest is grass.
- `by_size` (list of [CropSizeClass](#cropsizeclass), default `[{"min_game_ha": 1.5, "shares": {"corn": 0.3, "grass": 0.1, "soil": 0.1, "wheat": 0.5}}, {"min_game_ ...`): Crop shares of OSM field groups by size class.
- `osm_tags` (table of string, default `{"maize": "corn", "corn": "corn", "grass": "", "hay": "", "wheat": "wheat", "barley": "wheat", "rye" ...`): OSM crop= -> crop key ("" = grass).

## CropSizeClass

- `min_game_ha` (number, required): Size class from this group size (game hectares); the first class reached wins.
- `shares` (table of number, required): Crop key or "grass" -> share.

## CurveParams

- `max_edge_game_m` (number, required): Split longer edges (paths are curvy).
- `min_radius_game_m` (number, required): Smallest curve radius: tighter places (hairpins) are smoothed locally.
- `relax_iterations` (integer, required): Passes of the local smoothing.
- `smooth_game_m` (number, required): Smoothing before rounding against grid jags (Gauss); the ends stay exact.
- `min_curve_edge_game_m` (number, required): Shorter edges allowed in curves (tight bends).
- `max_turn_deg` (number, required): Largest bend between two edges.
- `hard_turn_deg` (number, required): A stronger bend stays anyway -> gap there.
- `chord_tol_game_m` (number, required): An edge follows the line with at most this deviation.

## DemDownload

Which elevation model to download for the crop (a value of the project or the GUI).

- `dem_type` (string, default `"GEDTM30"`): Elevation model of the API: GEDTM30 (terrain without trees and houses), EU_DTM, COP30 (surface with forest and houses), NASADEM, SRTMGL1, AW3D30.
- `margin_km` (number, default `1.0`): Margin around the crop (the terrain is cut exactly later).
- `url` (string, default `"https://portal.opentopography.org/API/globaldem"`): Address of the API.

## EconomySettings

The climate's economy (a value of the preset).

- `custom` (boolean, default `false`): Own economy (no oil platforms, refinery at oil wells, glass works at sand pits); false = the game's economy.
- `extra_industries` (boolean, default `false`): Also unlock industries and cargos of other climates (needs the mod DHE Industries).
- `water_industry_fraction` (string, default `"3.0 / 41.0"`): Share of water industries among new industries (temperate: 6 / 41).
- `name` (string, default `"Alps"`): Name of the own economy.
- `name_with_extra_industries` (string, default `"Alps (all industries)"`): Name of the own economy with extra industries.
- `removed_industries` (list of string, default `["oil_platform"]`): Industries the own economy leaves out.

## EconomyTexts

- `standard` ([BilingualText](#bilingualtext), required): Paragraph for the game's economy.
- `custom` ([BilingualText](#bilingualtext), required): Paragraph for the own economy.

## ForestParams

- `density` (number, required): Tree probability per cell in the forest mask (original game about 0.06-0.1).
- `single_trees_outside` (number, required): Share of the game's single trees kept outside the forest mask (0 = none).
- `index_lowland` (integer, required): Tree set index for broadleaf in biome 1 (6 = temperate_plains).
- `index_hills` (integer, required): Tree set index for broadleaf in biome 2 (3 = temperate_hills).
- `index_conifer` (integer, required): Tree set index for conifers (7 = temperate_conifer).
- `conifer_start` (number, required): Below this elevation mixed forest with conifer_share_below conifers (m a.s.l.).
- `conifer_full` (number, required): From this elevation only conifers (m a.s.l.).
- `conifer_share_below` (number, required): Conifer share below conifer_start.
- `max_steepness` (number, required): No trees from this steepness (keep slightly below the steep rock start).
- `classic` ([ClassicTrees](#classictrees) \| none, default `null`): Classic Trees (TF2 trees of the base game) mixed in; absent: off.

## GameArea

An area the base climate computes itself (names resolved by the climate adapter): "lowland" (biome 1/2),
"alpine_grass", "alpine_ground", "rock", "scree".

- `kind` ("game", default `"game"`)
- `name` (string, required): Area of the base climate.

## GameGroundRules

How own layers extend the base climate's own ground rules: the rock layer adds rock (steep) and scree (flat)
to the game's rock and scree; the forest floor follows the forest layer.

- `rock_layer` (string, required): Layer that adds rock (steep) and scree (flat).
- `forest_floor_layer` (string, required): Layer that defines the forest floor.
- `steep_rock` ([SteepnessRange](#steepnessrange), required): Rock on steep slopes (game rule; original 0.7 / 0.75; smaller = rock already on gentler slopes).

## GameMaterial

Terrain material of the base game, e.g. "grass_green".

- `kind` ("game", default `"game"`)
- `name` (string, required): Terrain material of the game (e.g. grass_green, scree, rock, gr_br_sub).

## GeoBounds

Rectangle in WGS84 degrees.

- `west` (number, required): Western edge: longitude in degrees (east positive).
- `south` (number, required): Southern edge: latitude in degrees (north positive).
- `east` (number, required): Eastern edge: longitude in degrees.
- `north` (number, required): Northern edge: latitude in degrees.

## GradientZone

Transition by latitude: 0 north of `start_lat`, rising linearly to 1 at `end_lat`, 1 beyond.

- `kind` ("gradient", default `"gradient"`)
- `start_lat` (number, required): Latitude where the transition starts (mask 0), degrees.
- `end_lat` (number, required): Latitude where the transition is complete (mask 1), degrees.

## HeightLimits

Real elevations of the climate's height rules in m a.s.l. (start = transition begins, full = 100 %).

- `scree_start` (number, required): Scree on flat ground starts.
- `scree_full` (number, required): Scree on flat ground full.
- `rock_start` (number, required): Rock starts (always also on steep slopes).
- `rock_full` (number, required): Rock full.
- `snow_hollow_start` (number, required): Snow in hollows starts.
- `snow_hollow_full` (number, required): Snow in hollows full.
- `snow_start` (number, required): Snow on surfaces starts.
- `snow_full` (number, required): Snow on surfaces full.
- `trees_dense_until` (number, required): Dense mountain forest up to here.
- `trees_sparse` (number, required): Sparse forest.
- `tree_line` (number, required): Tree line.
- `mountains_min` (number, required): Mountain mask only from here.

## IndustryNamesModSettings

Settings of the industry names mod (a value of configs/map_mods.toml).

- `wait_ticks` (integer, required): Wait this many simulation steps after loading.
- `recheck_ticks` (integer, required): Then check for new industries this often (simulation steps).
- `log_examples` (integer, required): Log this many renamings one by one (to check the name stem).

## IndustrySettings

The industry planning of a climate (a value of the climate preset).

- `sites` ([SiteParams](#siteparams), required): Building sites, suitability and resource areas.
- `plan` ([PlanParams](#planparams), required): Placement, town specialisation, demand, foreign trade.
- `naming` ([NamingParams](#namingparams), required): Industry names after the nearest place.
- `standard_only` (boolean, default `true`): Only the game's standard buildings: no compact variants, no industries and cargos of other climates, no foreign trade (import without the industry mod).
- `extra_industries` (list of string, default `[]`): Industries of other climates in the industry mod.
- `extra_cargos` (list of string, default `[]`): Cargos of other climates in the industry mod.
- `mod` ([ModFiles](#modfiles), default `{"mod_id": "DHE_industries_1", "folder": "industries/dhe", "trade_mod_id": "DHE_foreign_trade_1", "t ...`): Building files of the industry mod.
- `preview_width` (integer, default `2000`): Width of the preview pictures in pixels.
- `short_names` (table of string, default `{}`): Short name per industry in the preview.
- `industry_colors` (table of [integer, integer, integer], default `{}`): Preview colour per raw-material industry.

## Lane

- `forward` (boolean, required): Driving direction.
- `offset` (number, required): Offset from the centre line.
- `width` (number, required): Lane width (metres).
- `modes` (list of string, required): Transport modes.

## LayerArea

An import layer as coverage; `hard` cuts the interpolated 0/1 mask at 0.5 (sharp edge).

- `kind` ("layer", default `"layer"`)
- `key` (string, required): Import layer.
- `hard` (boolean, default `false`): Sharp edge (cut the interpolated mask at 0.5).

## LayerSpec

An import layer of the climate. The key in `layers` is both the suffix of the mask file `<map>_<key>.png` and
the layer's name in the game's import dialog, which lists the layers sorted by key like the files.

- `color` ([number, number, number], required): Colour of the layer in the import dialog (r, g, b 0..1).
- `slot` (integer, required): Layer slot ID 0-11 (the game ignores higher IDs).
- `resolution` (integer, required): Stored resolution in m per pixel (at least 4; 8 saves a lot of memory on large maps).

## Look

How a surface looks. `base`: own material output, or a game material replacing the material of the game's own
output for a game area, or absent (keep the game's look). `patches` lie on top of the surface.

- `base` ([MaterialOutput](#materialoutput) \| [GameMaterial](#gamematerial) \| none, default `null`): Base material (absent = keep the game's look).
- `patches` (table of [PatchLayer](#patchlayer), default `{}`): Patch layers on top, by name.

## MapModText

Title and mod hub texts of one kind of map mod (a value of configs/map_mods.toml).

- `title` (string, required): Middle part of the mod name, e.g. "Roads".
- `summary` (string, required): Short text in the mod hub.
- `description` (string, required): Description in the mod hub ({map} = the map's name).
- `tags` (list of string, default `[]`): Tags in the mod hub.

## MaterialOutput

A painted material: paint order (higher on top) and dithering (False = hard edge).

- `kind` ("output", default `"output"`)
- `material` ([GameMaterial](#gamematerial) \| [ModMaterial](#modmaterial), required): Material.
- `order` (integer, required): Paint order: higher lies on top (game: grass 0-20, forest floor 400, gravel 500, scree 1000/10000, rock 2000, snow 12000, riverbed 80000).
- `dither` (boolean, required): Dithered blending with the ground below (false = hard edge).

## ModFiles

The buildings of the industry mod "DHE Industries" and "DHE Foreign Trade" (compact, other climates, trade).

- `mod_id` (string, default `"DHE_industries_1"`): Mod ID of the industry mod.
- `folder` (string, default `"industries/dhe"`): Folder of its constructions below content/.
- `trade_mod_id` (string, default `"DHE_foreign_trade_1"`): Mod ID of the foreign trade mod.
- `trade_folder` (string, default `"industries/dhe_trade"`): Folder of its construction below content/.

## ModMaterial

Terrain material shipped in the climate mod: content/terrain/materials/<folder>/<file>.tmat.

- `kind` ("mod", default `"mod"`)
- `folder` (string, required): Folder of the own material in the mod.
- `file` (string, required): File of the own material (without .tmat).

## NamingParams

- `place_types` (table of number, required): "<place> <type>" after the nearest OSM place: distance factor per place kind (larger places preferred).
- `max_game_m` (number, required): Farther than this: the nearest planned town.
- `type_names` (table of string, required): Type name per industry (also used by the name mod).

## NoiseSpec

Settings of the game's fractal_noise_map.

- `frequency` (number, required): Noise frequency: larger = smaller patches.
- `lacunarity` (number, required): Frequency factor between noise octaves.
- `octaves` (integer, required): Number of noise octaves (detail levels).
- `gain` (number, required): Strength factor between noise octaves.

## OverlayMix

The primary look stays complete; the secondary look is painted on top of it on the whole surface with the
share as strength, varied by a large noise.

- `kind` ("overlay", default `"overlay"`)
- `noise` ([NoiseSpec](#noisespec), required): Noise that varies the strength (frequency: larger = smaller variations).
- `variation` (number, required): Relative variation of the strength (0.3 = share x 0.7 .. 1.3; 0 = even).

## PatchLayer

Patches of another material on top of a surface (the key in `patches` names the material output).

- `output` ([MaterialOutput](#materialoutput), required): Material of the patches.
- `patch` ([PatchSpec](#patchspec), required): Patch pattern.

## PatchMix

The secondary look appears in noise patches; `edge` = softness of the patch border (0 = hard).

- `kind` ("patches", default `"patches"`)
- `noise` ([NoiseSpec](#noisespec), required): Noise of the patches (frequency: larger = smaller patches).
- `edge` (number, required): Softness of the patch border in noise units (0 = hard).

## PatchSpec

Noise patches covering about `share` of an area.

The noise threshold is t = 1 - 2 * share; coverage ramps from 0 to the intensity over a window of width `edge`
centred at t + `center_offset`.

- `share` (number, required): About the area share of the patches (0 = none).
- `noise` ([NoiseSpec](#noisespec), required): Noise that forms the patches.
- `center_offset` (number, required): Shift of the patch edge in the noise (technical, keep).
- `edge` (number, required): Softness of the patch edge (width of the transition in the noise; 0.1 = hard).
- `intensity` ([ConstantIntensity](#constantintensity) \| [VaryingIntensity](#varyingintensity), required): Material strength inside the patches.
- `slope_limit` ([SlopeLimit](#slopelimit) \| none, default `null`): Patches only on gentle slopes (absent: on every slope).

## PathNetworkParams

- `gap_game_m` (number, required): Gap around branches and crossings (distance to another path or a planned road).
- `min_run_game_m` (number, required): Shorter sections are left out (stubs).
- `min_arm_game_m` (number, required): Arms at junctions are left out only below this length.
- `snap_game_m` (number, required): A path end this close to another path becomes a branch there.
- `cross_game_m` (number, required): Two paths this close become a crossing.
- `min_junction_deg` (number, required): More acute angles between two arms: the shorter arm is detached (gap).
- `mixed_junctions` (boolean, required): Junctions between field tracks and hiking paths (different street types).

## PathStreetModSettings

Settings of the path street mod (a value of configs/map_mods.toml).

- `test_area` ([BuildArea](#buildarea) \| none, default `null`): Absent: the whole map; else only a test section.
- `network` ([PathNetworkParams](#pathnetworkparams), required): Junctions, long sections, gaps.
- `curves` ([CurveParams](#curveparams), required): Curves and nodes.
- `clear_game_m` (number, required): In game: leave a node out if a street lies this close already (town streets are not in the plan; path ends near other streets crash the game).
- `street_types` (table of [StreetType](#streettype), required): Street type per path kind of the path plan.
- `max_slope` (number, required): Steepest slope of the street types (1 = 45°; the game's country roads much less).
- `flip_y` (boolean, required): If the paths lie mirrored at the north-south axis in game.
- `description` (string, required): Description of the street types in the game (English, {name} = name).
- `description_de` (string, required): Description of the street types in the game (German, {name} = German name).

## PlanParams

- `seed` (integer, required): Random seed of the placement.
- `raw_resource` (table of string, required): Raw-material industry -> resource area.
- `intermediate` (list of string, required): Intermediate products, preferably in medium towns.
- `complex` (list of string, required): Complex products, preferably in large towns.
- `production_per_type` (table of integer, required): Count per processing type (default 1; local goods).
- `medium_town_capacity` (number, required): Towns from this start capacity are medium (intermediate products) ...
- `large_town_capacity` (number, required): ... and from this large (complex products); below: villages, agriculture.
- `specializations` (table of integer, required): Factories per town class (village, medium, large).
- `equal_town_slots` (integer, required): Factories per town when the real town size is ignored (all towns medium).
- `import_cost_game_m` (number, required): An input without source on the map (foreign trade) counts as this far.
- `own_allowed` (list of string, required): Towns do not demand their own products - except these.
- `trade_points` (integer, required): Foreign trade points at the map edge (0 = none).
- `trade_spread_m_per_km` (number, required): Distance to other trade points: per km like this many metres lower.
- `trade_edge_game_m` (number, required): Trade points at most this far from the (inner) map edge.
- `producer_pref` (table of string, required): Cargo -> preferred producer.
- `town_cargos` (table of [integer, string], required): Town cargo -> (level, "com"/"ind"); levels 0 and 1 at start.
- `far_cargos` (list of string, required): Long-distance cargos.
- `local_only` (list of string, required): Only for towns up to local_max_game_m from the resource area.
- `local_max_game_m` (number, required): See local_only.
- `far_min_capacity` (number, required): From this start capacity one long-distance cargo (commercial/industrial in turns; all towns when the real town size is ignored).
- `balance_game_m` (number, required): Local cargos: per town served already (per producer) this much detour.
- `towns_per_local_producer` (integer, required): Towns one factory or farm supplies (assumption for the amounts).
- `towns_per_far_producer` (integer, required): Towns one long-distance producer supplies.
- `max_per_type` (integer, required): At most this many per industry type ...
- `agriculture` (list of string, required): ... except agriculture (at least one per area, by demand).
- `factory_town_game_m` (number, required): Factories at most this far from their town.
- `raw_town_game_m` ([number, number], required): Mines etc.: suitability rises with the distance to the next town (from .. to).
- `agri_town_game_m` ([number, number], required): Agriculture: suitability rises with the nearness to a town.
- `spacing_game_m` (number, required): Minimum distance between industries.
- `map_edge_game_m` (number, required): Distance to the map edge.
- `region_edge_game_m` (number, required): Raw-material industries also this far outside their area.
- `compact` (list of string, required): Compact variant in the mountains (mod buildings).
- `compact_mountain_share` (number, required): Compact if the area is mountains to more than this share ...
- `compact_field_share` (number, required): ... or has less than this share of sites for the large variant.
- `fish_shore_game_m` (number, required): Fishing grounds this far from the shore.
- `on_water` (list of string, required): Industries placed on water.

## PublishingSettings

Names, author and images of the published mods (a value of configs/publishing.toml).

- `prefix` (string, required): Prefix of all mod names and IDs.
- `beta_tag` (string, default `""`): Tag at the end of the climate mods' names and IDs (empty = none).
- `author` (string, required): Author in the mod hub.
- `thumbnail` ([ThumbnailFiles](#thumbnailfiles), default `{"size": [1400, 800], "file": "image_00.tga", "cover_file": "_metadata/0.png"}`): Mod thumbnail.
- `stamp` ([StampSettings](#stampsettings), default `{"font": "segoeuib.ttf", "line_height": 0.2}`): Text on the images.

## RealWaterParams

- `edge_smooth_game_m` (number, default `10`): Smooth the edge of real water at full resolution (0 = off).
- `bed_ramp_game_m` (number, default `40`): Bed falls from the shore to the bottom over this width (0 = step).
- `bed_smooth_game_m` (number, default `6`): Blur of the bed ramp (0 = off).
- `shore_width_game_m` (number, default `60`): Width of the shore strip next to real water that is smoothed.
- `shore_smooth_game_m` (number, default `12`): Smoothing radius of that shore strip (0 = off).

## ResourceSpec

- `industries` (list of string, required): Industry types of this resource.
- `sites` (list of string, required): Site kinds the industries can use.
- `regions` (integer, required): Number of areas.
- `smooth_game_m` (number, required): Smoothing of the suitability.
- `color` ([integer, integer, integer], required): Preview colour.
- `label` (string, required): Legend of the preview.
- `peak` (number \| none, default `null`): Own area threshold (default: region_peak_share).
- `radius_game_m` (number \| none, default `null`): Own area radius (default: region_radius_game_m).
- `spacing_game_m` (number \| none, default `null`): Own peak spacing (default: region_spacing_game_m).
- `height_m` ([number, number, number, number], default `[-1000000.0, -1000000.0, 1000000.0, 1000000.0]`): Real height band of the suitability in m a.s.l. (from 0, full from, full to, to 0); unused by fish.

## RoadModSettings

Settings of the road mod (a value of configs/map_mods.toml).

- `road_era` (string, required): Street type: key in road_templates ("new" = country road new from 1940, "old" = old until 1940).
- `road_templates` (table of string, required): Street template per era.
- `bridge_types` (list of [number, string], required): Bridge type by length: (longest bridge in game m, end of the type's file name), shortest first.
- `tunnel_type` (string, required): End of the tunnel type's file name.
- `auto_start` (boolean, required): Start building shortly after the game starts (else on the start signal).
- `start_marker` (string, required): Start signal: a street built by the player whose type contains this.
- `max_edge_game_m` (number, required): Split longer pieces (the road follows the terrain at the points).
- `min_edge_game_m` (number, required): Merge shorter pieces.
- `remove_buildings` (boolean, required): Tear down buildings in the way (else rather a gap).
- `flip_y` (boolean, required): If the roads lie mirrored at the north-south axis in game.

## RoadTestSettings

Settings of the road test mod (a value of configs/road_test.toml).

- `template` (string, required): Street template of the test roads.
- `walls_mod_id` (string, required): Mod ID of DHE_Walls_Tracks_Streets (its resources are also looked up as <mod ID>::/...).
- `steep_template` (string, required): Steep street template of DHE_Walls_Tracks_Streets (T5).
- `lower_walls` (list of string, required): Names tried for the retaining wall below the road (fill; edge decoration).
- `upper_walls` (list of string, required): Names tried for the retaining wall above the road (cut).
- `wall_from_m` (number, required): T5: walls where the line lies more than this above (fill) or below (cut) the ground.
- `bridge_types` (list of string, required): Names tried for the bridge type (the first one the game knows is used; all are logged).
- `tunnel_types` (list of string, required): Names tried for the tunnel type.
- `bridge_above_m` (number, required): Profile line: bridge where the line lies more than this above the ground.
- `tunnel_below_m` (number, required): Profile line: tunnel where the line lies more than this below the ground.
- `line_length_m` (number, required): Length of the profile lines (straight, constant grade between the ground at both ends).
- `edge_length_m` (number, required): Length of the edges.
- `line_offset_m` (number, required): Distance between the test roads.
- `branch_length_m` (number, required): Length of the branch from the middle node of the second profile line (junction).
- `radii_m` (list of number, required): Hairpins with these radii.
- `leg_length_m` (number, required): Length of the straight legs of the hairpins.

## RockAssetParams

- `max_density` (number, required): Rock probability per cell at strength 1 (original subarctic: tundra 0.1, coast 0.45).
- `mountain` (number, required): Strength in the mountains (above the tree line or rock layer, without water).
- `forest` (number, required): Strength in the forest.
- `shore` (number, required): Strength on the shore (when not like the riverbed).
- `riverbed` (number, required): Strength in the riverbed (without patches; 1.0 was too dense).
- `waterfall_test` (boolean, default `false`): Diagnostic: rocks on ALL painted water at full density.
- `shore_like_riverbed` (boolean, required): Shore gets the riverbed density without patches.
- `sets` (list of [string, number], required): Rock sets of the game (categoryList) with their share of the mix.
- `patch_share` (number, required): Rocks in patches: about the area share (1 = everywhere, evenly).
- `patch_frequency` (number, required): Noise frequency of the rock patches (larger = smaller patches).
- `patch_edge` (number, required): Width of the transition at the patch edge (0 = hard).
- `waterfall` ([WaterfallRocks](#waterfallrocks) \| none, default `null`): Rocks on waterfalls; absent: none.

## SiteKind

- `radius_game_m` (number, required): Radius of the footprint ...
- `relief_game_m` (number, required): ... and the largest height difference in it.
- `color` ([integer, integer, integer], required): Preview colour.
- `label` (string, required): Legend of the preview.

## SiteParams

- `work_px` (integer, required): Work grid: heightmap pixels per cell (4 = 16 game metres).
- `sites` (table of [SiteKind](#sitekind), required): Building sites: footprint and largest height difference per kind (factory, field, compact).
- `town_clear_game_m` (number, required): Distance of sites to town centres.
- `site_near_game_m` (number, required): Share of sites within this radius enters the suitability ...
- `site_full_share` (number, required): ... fully from this share (weaker below, down to 0).
- `local_game_m` (number, required): Landcover counts as share within this radius.
- `noise` (number, required): Suitability x (1 - noise + noise x noise field 0..1) ...
- `noise_game_m` (number, required): ... with this structure size.
- `seed` (integer, required): Random seed of the noise.
- `resources` (table of [ResourceSpec](#resourcespec), required): Resource areas: industries, site kinds, number, smoothing.
- `region_peak_share` (number, required): Area = region above this share of its own peak.
- `region_radius_game_m` (number, required): Area at most this far around the peak.
- `region_spacing_game_m` (number, required): Minimum distance between the peaks of one resource.
- `region_min_km2` (number, required): Smaller areas are dropped (game area).

## SlopeLimit

Only up to `max_deg` slope, faded out over `fade_deg` below it (degrees via the tan² assumption).

- `max_deg` (number, required): Patches only up to this slope in game (degrees; tan² assumption unverified).
- `fade_deg` (number, required): Patches fade out over this many degrees below the maximum.

## SlotPlan

Own layers plus the original layers of the base climate on the 12 slots.

- `layers` (table of [LayerSpec](#layerspec), required): Own import layers by key.
- `original` (table of integer, required): Layers of the base climate that keep their slot.

## SoftMix

Both looks are blended by the share everywhere (no patches).

- `kind` ("soft", default `"soft"`)

## StampSettings

- `font` (string, default `"segoeuib.ttf"`): Font of the text printed on mod images (file name or path; missing = Pillow's default font).
- `line_height` (number, default `0.2`): Font height per line as share of the image height.

## SteepWaterArea

Inside `water` where the water surface itself is steep (waterfall), soft transition.

- `kind` ("steep_water", default `"steep_water"`)
- `water` ([LayerArea](#layerarea) \| [GameArea](#gamearea) \| [AreaProduct](#areaproduct) \| [SteepWaterArea](#steepwaterarea), required): Water area.
- `steepness` ([SteepnessRange](#steepnessrange), required): Steepness of the water surface for the waterfall.
- `blur_sigma` (number, required): Blur of the steepness for a soft transition (game blur_map, unit probably cells).
- `blur_size` (integer, required): Blur kernel size.
- `edge_sigma` (number, required): Only slopes inside the water count: blur of the water mask (0 = edge slopes count).
- `edge_size` (integer, required): Kernel size of the water mask blur.
- `edge_inner` (number, required): Inside = blurred water mask at least this value (closer to 1 = further from the edge).
- `gain` (number, required): Strength = min(1, blurred steepness x gain).

## SteepnessRange

Ramp in the game's steepness measure (gradient_map "X^2 + Y^2", assumed tan²): 0 below `start`, 1 from `full`.

- `start` (number, required): Steepness where the ramp starts (about tan² of the slope; 0.03 ~ 10°, 0.1 ~ 18°, 0.33 ~ 30°).
- `full` (number, required): Steepness of full strength; must be above start.

## StreetType

- `file` (string, required): File name of the street type.
- `name` (string, required): Name in the game (English).
- `name_de` (string, required): Name in the game (German).
- `fill` (string, required): Ground texture under the street (material).
- `lane_overlay` (boolean, required): Driving lanes of the old country road on top.
- `lanes` (list of [Lane](#lane), required): Lanes (walkway, lane, lane, walkway).
- `street_modes` (list of string, required): Transport modes of the street.
- `speed` (number, required): Speed (m/s).

## Surface

A kind of ground (the key in `surfaces` names it and its base material output).

- `area` ([LayerArea](#layerarea) \| [GameArea](#gamearea) \| [AreaProduct](#areaproduct) \| [SteepWaterArea](#steepwaterarea), required): Where the surface lies.
- `look` ([Look](#look), default `{"base": null, "patches": {}}`): How the surface looks.

## SurfaceTransition

- `factor` ([BiomeFactor](#biomefactor), required): Share of the secondary look.
- `mix` ([PatchMix](#patchmix) \| [SoftMix](#softmix) \| [OverlayMix](#overlaymix) \| none, default `null`): Own mix function for this surface (absent = the transition's mix).

## ThumbnailFiles

- `size` ([integer, integer], default `[1400, 800]`): Size of the mod thumbnail (px).
- `file` (string, default `"image_00.tga"`): Thumbnail in the mod folder (the game shows it in the local mod list).
- `cover_file` (string, default `"_metadata/0.png"`): Cover in the mod folder (mod hub; where the game puts it itself).

## Transition

A second look on part of the map: the secondary preset is the primary one with the differences in `secondary`
(merged table by table, like parameter sets).

- `name` (string, required): Name of the landscape with this transition (used in the climate mod's name instead of the preset's).
- `secondary` (table, required): Differences of the secondary preset to the primary one.
- `zone` ([GradientZone](#gradientzone), required): Where the secondary look applies.
- `layer` ([TransitionLayer](#transitionlayer), required): Import layer of the transition mask.
- `mix` ([PatchMix](#patchmix) \| [SoftMix](#softmix) \| [OverlayMix](#overlaymix), required): How the two looks are mixed.
- `surfaces` (table of [SurfaceTransition](#surfacetransition), required): Surfaces that change, by key, and their shares.

## TransitionLayer

The import layer of the transition mask.

- `color` ([number, number, number], required): Colour of the layer in the import dialog (r, g, b 0..1).
- `slot` (integer, required): Layer slot ID 0-11 (the game ignores higher IDs).
- `resolution` (integer, required): Stored resolution in m per pixel (at least 4; 8 saves a lot of memory on large maps).
- `key` (string, required): Layer key in the climate (the map graph writes the mask as <map>_transition_mask.png).

## VaryingIntensity

Intensity varies by a second noise between `low` and `high`.

- `kind` ("varying", default `"varying"`)
- `low` (number, required): Lowest material strength inside a patch (0..1).
- `high` (number, required): Highest material strength inside a patch (0..1).
- `noise` ([NoiseSpec](#noisespec), required): Noise that varies the strength.

## WaterfallRocks

Rock assets where the waterfall surface lies (its steepness ramp and inner mask, without blur).

- `strength` (number, required): Rock strength on waterfalls (x max_density; 0 = none).
- `surface` (string, required): Surface whose steep water area places the rocks.

## WaterfallSettings

Waterfall brush textures: water_dirty colour with white foam, seamless in all directions (a value of
configs/waterfall.toml).

- `name` (string, required): Brush name in game (German via the translations).
- `size_px` (integer, required): Texture size (original 4096; 2048 = about 5.6 MB instead of 22 MB per brush).
- `foam_color` ([integer, integer, integer], required): Foam colour sRGB.
- `softness` (number, required): Transition water -> foam (larger = softer).
- `clump_px` (number, required): Size of the foam clumps in texture pixels (4096 px = 32 m).
- `grain_px` (number, required): Size of the fine spray in texture pixels.
- `foam_gloss` (number, required): Gloss factor in the foam (1 = like water, 0 = matt).
- `seed` (integer, required): Random seed.
- `variants` (table of [WaterfallVariant](#waterfallvariant), required): Brushes by label (one per variant, about 5.6 MB each).
- `image` (string, required): Photo for the photo variants (relative to the working directory).
- `image_highpass_px` (number, required): Background smoothing of the photo (image pixels).
- `wave_px` (integer, required): Distance of the wave crests in texture pixels (4096 px = 32 m).
- `wave_warp` (number, required): Bending of the wave crests (in wave distances).
- `wave_warp_scale` (number, required): Size of the bending (in wave distances).
- `first_order` (integer, required): Brush order in the game menu of the first variant.

## WaterfallVariant

One brush (the key in `variants` is its label: name suffix of the brush, dhe_waterfall_<label>).

- `foam_share` (number, required): About the foam share of the area (0..1).
- `strength` (number, required): Foam strength (1 = full white).
- `grain_weight` (number, required): Share of the fine spray in the pattern (0..1, rest = clumps).
- `pattern` ("-" \| "h" \| "v" \| "img" \| "img90" \| "imgmix", required): Pattern: "-" noise, "h"/"v" waves, "img"/"img90"/"imgmix" photo.
